events.title: Tupac Shakur Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the impact of Tupac Shakur, whose music continues to resonate decades on since his tragic passing in 1996.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away in London.

angles.name: Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar icon who left us far too soon, 56 years ago today.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles delivered a true masterpiece with 'Abbey Road'. That iconic album cover is still instantly recognisable.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today marks the 75th birthday of The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born in Akron, Ohio in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: A very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, still rocking with The Pretenders and inspiring generations.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: A very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still a rock 'n' roll star.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave the world the powerful and enduring message of 'Imagine'. A timeless album.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed music forever with the launch of the original iPod. A quarter-century of pocket-sized tunes!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred – it's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: A very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese. Still making us laugh after all these years.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the monumental 'White Album'. A true landmark in music history.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary, 35 years on.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles unveiled 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose profound impact on music and peace continues to inspire, 46 years after his passing.
